address: Kimbolton Road, Bolnhurst, MK44 2EX, United Kingdom
bio: Sit in the rustic bar, modern restaurant or lovely garden of this charming whitewashed pub with Tudor origins. Menus are named after ploughing terms: ‘The Seam’ makes use of offcuts from main menu ‘The Furrow’. British and Mediterranean influences combine and there’s a great cheese selection....
